controlObservations.subject: qualification-inputs/rc7-held-session-author-02/prior-author-lanes.mjs
controlObservations.relation: Line 81 throws 'Selected finite per-lane bound and positive filter required' unless lane.timeoutMs===300000. C2_INPUTS lanes fixed-route and fixed-route-correction declare timeoutMs 600000 (the Root-selected primary bound). Line 74 creates the lane allocation directory before line 81, so invoking fixed-route deterministically reserves an allocation with no summary; every later lane and stage invocation then stops with 'Prior lane allocation incomplete'. Guard and caller lanes require a passed fixed-route first.
controlObservations.standing: Static read of the supplied harness; not executed. The Worker cannot edit qualification-inputs. Running fixed-route would consume an allocation for a known harness refusal and block all remaining lanes and stage02, so this Worker does not invoke it unless Root corrects the control.
